[EVENT] User plans to visit Bangkok next month.  
[PREFERENCE] User expresses excitement about trying street food in Bangkok.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommended street food items in Bangkok:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Pad Thai - stir-fried rice noodles with shrimp, tofu, beansprouts, egg, and peanuts.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Som Tam - spicy green papaya salad made with fish sauce, lime juice, garlic, chili, and green beans.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. Sate - grilled skewered meat such as chicken, beef, or pork served with peanut sauce.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 4. Mango Sticky Rice - sweet dessert made with glutinous rice, coconut milk, and fresh mango.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 5. Grilled seafood - fresh seafood such as prawns, squid, and fish grilled to perfection.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 6. Khanom Buang - Thai-style crepes filled with coconut cream and shredded coconut.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 7. Roti - crispy and flaky pancakes served plain or filled with banana, egg, and condensed milk.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 8. Khao Man Gai - poached chicken and rice dish served with spicy chili sauce and ginger sauce.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 9. Moo Ping - grilled pork skewers marinated in garlic, soy sauce, and sugar.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 10. Bamee GOP - egg noodles served with minced pork, mushrooms, garlic, and soy sauce.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Suggested popular areas in Bangkok for street food:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Chinatown (Yaowarat) - a haven for street food lovers offering a variety of Chinese and Thai food.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Sukhumvit Soi 38 - a popular street food spot for authentic Thai cuisine including Pad Thai and Mango Sticky Rice.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. Chatuchak Weekend Market - a huge market with a variety of street food options including grilled seafood, noodles, and Thai desserts.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 4. Victory Monument - a hub of street food stalls with local specialties such as boat noodles and grilled chicken.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 5. Silom Soi 20 - famous for its grilled meats, seafood, and Thai desserts.
